title: Reorganize String
description: Given a string `s`, rearrange the characters of `s` so that any two adjacent characters are not the same. Return any valid rearrangement, or empty line if impossible.
output_format: The rearranged string or empty line.

sample_tests.explanation: No two adjacent characters are equal.

hints: Count character frequencies and push into a max-heap.
Pop the most frequent character, append it to the result, and hold it aside.
Push it back only after another character has been placed next.

reference_solution:
import sys, heapq
s = sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\r\n')
from collections import Counter
counts = Counter(s)
pq = [(-cnt, ch) for ch, cnt in counts.items()]
heapq.heapify(pq)
res = []
prev_cnt, prev_ch = 0, ''
while pq:
    cnt, ch = heapq.heappop(pq)
    res.append(ch)
    if prev_cnt < 0:
        heapq.heappush(pq, (prev_cnt, prev_ch))
    prev_cnt = cnt + 1
    prev_ch = ch
ans = ''.join(res)
print(ans if len(ans) == len(s) else '')
